statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-3805: when curl makes a second SMB request to the same host, reusing the connection, it could use a pointer to the request path that points into memory already freed (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-3805.html). It affects curl 8.13.0 to 8.18.0 and was fixed in curl 8.19.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/e090be9f73a7a71459ef678c7cc4b1f75e3ea883, which gives each request its own copy of the path in lib/smb.c and frees it with the request. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 (in both the main and the security repository), 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. The libcurl builds 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 and 8.19.0-r0 include SMB support: on x86_64 and aarch64 their shared libcurl carries the SMB module's error messages, and the static libcurl.a in curl-static has an SMB object (smb.o) defining the SMB and SMBS protocol handlers. Alpine records CVE-2026-3805 as fixed in 8.19.0-r0 (https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/3.23-stable/main/curl/APKBUILD). In that static libcurl.a, smb_easy_dtor in 8.19.0-r0 frees the request's own path copy before freeing the request, while in 8.17.0-r1 and in both 8.18.0-r0 builds (main and security repository) it frees only the request, on both architectures. So 8.19.0-r0, the first build of curl 8.19.0, is the first fixed build.

CVE-2026-3805: when curl makes a second SMB request to the same host, reusing the connection, it could use a pointer to the request path that points into memory already freed (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-3805.html). It affects curl 8.13.0 to 8.18.0 and was fixed in curl 8.19.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/e090be9f73a7a71459ef678c7cc4b1f75e3ea883, which gives each request its own copy of the path in lib/smb.c and frees it with the request. Debian backported the fix to trixie in 8.14.1-2+deb13u4 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-3805). The DHI curl packages for Debian 13 are rebuilds of Debian's trixie curl 8.14.1-2; the DHI Debian repository publishes three of them (the rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u5 and two rebuilds of 8.14.1-2+deb13u7) for amd64 and arm64. Their libcurl.so.4.8.0 (libcurl4t64) and libcurl-gnutls.so.4.8.0 (libcurl3t64-gnutls) include SMB support: every one of them, on both architectures, carries the SMB module's error messages. Every published build is based on 8.14.1-2+deb13u5 or later, and the Debian changelog each one ships (in libcurl4t64 and libcurl3t64-gnutls, on both architectures) records the fix under 8.14.1-2+deb13u4, so the lowest published build, the rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u5, is the fixed version used here. Earlier rebuilds of 8.14.1-2+deb13u3 and before, which this request also matches, are no longer published; they are based on Debian releases from before the fix and sort below the fixed version.
